## Classes

### `class DisplayRefreshEstimator`

Robustly estimates the host display cadence from requestAnimationFrame intervals. Missed callbacks are filtered before estimation, so a busy frame does not incorrectly turn a 144 Hz display into a 72 Hz quality target.

| --- | --- | --- |
| `constructor` | `constructor(options = {})` |  |
| `record` | `record(intervalMs)` |  |
| `reset` | `reset(initialHz = this._refreshHz)` |  |
